name: Notes, schedule entries and to-dos
description: Short Japanese sentences a person might type or say into a notes app: a schedule entry (予定), a to-do (ToDo) or a memo (メモ). `seeds` are the few examples a user could have given as samples; `test` is the held-out set, with the tricky ones marked (a memo that contains a date, a to-do with a deadline, a schedule without a clock time). `now` is the date the relative expressions are resolved against (a Wednesday). In `test`, schedule items carry the expected `date` / `time` / `endDate` / `allDay`, and to-dos with a deadline the expected `due`. Hand-written for this demo. `unseen` holds schedule sentences with other phrasings, written after the date rules, to see how far the rules reach beyond the test set (nothing was changed for them before the first run).

labels.name: 予定
labels.description: カレンダーに入れる予定。日時や場所が決まっている会合・約束・出来事

labels.name: ToDo
labels.description: やるべき作業。買い物、連絡、手続き、提出など、自分が行う行動

labels.name: メモ
labels.description: 覚えておきたい情報。事実、アイデア、感想、番号、好みなど。日時の約束や作業ではない
